blocks.prompt: 13. Find the \(8^{\text{th}}\) term from the end of the A.P. \(8, 11, 14, \ldots, 185\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh A.P. mehdood (finite) hai: 8 se shuru ho kar 185 par khatam hoti hai.
Find kya karna hai? Aakhir se ginti karein to 8th term kaunsi hai.
Plan: list ko ulta parhein; ulti list bhi A.P. hai jo 185 se shuru hoti hai aur har qadam 3 kam hoti hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(8, 11, 14, \ldots, 185\)
Humein find karna hai: aakhir se 8th term.
Tareeqa: List ulti kar dein to pehli term \(l = 185\) aur common difference \(-d\) ban jata hai. Is ulti A.P. ki 8th term \(l - 7d\) hai. Is tareeqe mein kul terms ginne ki zaroorat bhi nahi parti.

Common difference
\[d = 11 - 8 = 3\]
Kyun: Saath wali terms mein 3 ka farq hai (\(14 - 11 = 3\) bhi). Aage ki taraf har term 3 barhti hai, to peeche ki taraf har term 3 ghat'ti hai. Isi liye ulti list ka common difference \(-3\) hai.
Misaal: seedhi par neeche se 8th seedhi aur oopar se 8th seedhi alag hoti hain; yahan humein oopar (aakhir) se ginna hai.

Aakhri term se saat qadam peeche jayein
\[\text{8th from end} = l - (8 - 1)d\]
\[= 185 - 7(3)\]
\[= 185 - 21 = 164\]
Kyun: Aakhri term khud aakhir se pehli term hai. Is se 8th tak 7 qadam peeche jana hai, har qadam 3 kam: \(7 \times 3 = 21\).
Dhyan dein: \(8 \times 3 = 24\) minus karna aam ghalti hai; jaise aage ginti mein \((n - 1)\) qadam hote hain, peeche bhi \((8 - 1) = 7\) qadam.

Tasdeeq: shuru se gin kar
\[185 = 8 + (n - 1)3 \Rightarrow n = 60\]
\[\text{8th from end} = a_{60 - 8 + 1} = a_{53}\]
\[a_{53} = 8 + 52(3) = 164 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Pehle kul terms nikaleen: 60. \(n\) terms wali list mein aakhir se \(k\)th term, shuru se \((n - k + 1)\)th hoti hai, yani 53rd. Us ki value bhi 164 aayi.
